parts.name: Tread bracket, open side
parts.bends: 1 bend, 90 deg toward the outside face: seat tab off the top edge
parts.notes: every tread (4 lower + 7 upper); west side of the upper flight, north side of the lower flight. 2 x 7/16 bolt holes into the stringer, 3 x 11/32 holes in the seat for 5/16 x 1 1/2 lags up into the tread.

parts.name: Tread bracket, wall side (mirror)
parts.bends: 1 bend, 90 deg toward the outside face: seat tab off the top edge
parts.notes: mirror image of the open side part. every tread (4 lower + 7 upper).

parts.name: Floor shoe under the lower stringer
parts.bends: 2 bends, both 90 deg the same way (cheeks up): a U channel with tabs past each end
parts.notes: the lower stringer's level foot stands on the base; the cheeks run up outside the first tread's bracket webs and share that bracket's lower bolt (6 in, cheek, web, tube, web, cheek, crush sleeve inside). One 3/8 slab anchor through each end tab (1/2 in holes).

parts.name: Stringer top clip, west side (both flights)
parts.bends: 1 bend, 90 deg (west and east are mirror images)
parts.notes: one pair at each stringer top (upper on the balcony head beam, lower on the landing header). Tube leg hole is a 1 in VERTICAL SLOT: one through bolt across the stringer (crush sleeve inside). Other leg bolts through the beam.

parts.name: Stringer top clip, east side (both flights)
parts.bends: 1 bend, 90 deg (west and east are mirror images)
parts.notes: one pair at each stringer top (upper on the balcony head beam, lower on the landing header). Tube leg hole is a 1 in VERTICAL SLOT: one through bolt across the stringer (crush sleeve inside). Other leg bolts through the beam.

parts.name: Upper stringer post saddle (seat, legs down the post, cheeks up the stringer, tabs to the landing beam)
parts.bends: 6 bends, all 90 deg: the 2 legs DOWN (a U over the post top), the 2 cheeks UP (a U round the stringer), and a tab off each cheek's south edge bent OUT, away from the stringer (bend the tabs before the cheeks)
parts.notes: seat 4.50 x 3.50 in outside; legs 3 in wide, 3.75 in outside, one 3/8 through bolt across the post; cheeks 2.25 in tall outside, one 3/8 through bolt across the stringer (crush sleeve inside); tabs 2.25 in out x 1.17 in tall, one 3/8 bolt each through the landing's north beam. Replaces round 5's foot clips.

parts.name: Foot post base plate, 6 x 6 (post passes through)
parts.notes: lower flight foot post; the 2 x 2 post stands through the square hole on the slab. COUNTERSINK the two 13/32 in holes from the BOTTOM face (82 deg, 3/8 flat head): flat head screws up through the plate into the post clips, nuts on top (no tapped threads). Four 1/2 in holes for 3/8 in slab anchors.

parts.name: Corner newel base plate, 6 x 6
parts.notes: corner newel stands on it. COUNTERSINK the two 13/32 in holes from the BOTTOM face (82 deg, 3/8 flat head): flat head screws up through the plate into the post clips, nuts on top (no tapped threads). Four 1/2 in holes for 3/8 in slab anchors.

parts.name: Upper stringer post base plate, 7 x 7
parts.notes: 3 x 3 post under the upper stringer's foot. COUNTERSINK the two 13/32 in holes from the BOTTOM face (82 deg, 3/8 flat head): flat head screws up through the plate into the post clips, nuts on top (no tapped threads). Four 1/2 in holes for 3/8 in slab anchors.

parts.name: Balcony post L plate (south west newel and north west post)
parts.notes: flat; the long leg bolts to the end beam of the balcony frame, the short leg up the post. Same part both posts (flip one).

parts.name: Clip angle 2 in wide, 1 3/4 legs
parts.notes: PLACEHOLDER for an engineer: 16 at the landing and balcony frame corners, 6 at the three post bases (2 each, flat heads up through the base plates). Round 7: the knee braces use gusset plates instead.

parts.name: Knee frame gusset, top
parts.notes: flat, one per knee frame (south and north): brace top to the balcony beam (2 bolts in the beam, 1 in the brace). On the face toward the middle of the balcony; 3/8 through bolts with crush sleeves.

parts.name: Knee frame gusset, foot
parts.notes: flat, one per knee frame (south and north): brace foot to the wall post (2 in the post, 1 in the brace). On the face toward the middle of the balcony; 3/8 through bolts with crush sleeves.

parts.name: Knee frame gusset, corner
parts.notes: flat, one per knee frame (south and north): wall post top to the balcony beam's end (1 in each). On the face toward the middle of the balcony; 3/8 through bolts with crush sleeves.

parts.name: Rail end clip 1 1/4 in wide, 1 1/2 legs
parts.notes: PLACEHOLDER for an engineer: straight rail ends into post faces, the north guard rail into the west one, the north guard rail at the bath 1 wall, and the four guard bottom rail ends. 9/32 in holes for 1/4-20.

parts.name: Rail to post strap 1 1/4 x 4 1/2
parts.notes: PLACEHOLDER for an engineer: flat strap on the side where a rail runs over a post top (lower rail on the foot post, guard top rails on the north west and north east posts); 1/4 in spacer behind it on the rail, which sits 1/4 in in from the post face.
